responsibility: Implements rendering of diagnostics::paths::path objects for human-readable output, especially classic text and HTML. This file owns event consolidation into printable runs, label generation for inline event ranges, control-flow link visualization, and the formatting algorithms that turn abstract path/thread/event data into source-annotated path explanations or per-event notes; it is the path presentation layer, separate from the underlying path data model in paths.cc/paths.h.
